# My Internship Notebook

> A free, private, notebook-style web app for organizing internship applications and browsing
> fresh internship openings. Installs on phones and computers and works offline.

Each application gets its own page for notes, contacts, and next steps. A board view tracks
the pipeline (Saved, Applied, Interview, Offer, Rejected), and an insights view summarizes
response rate, interview rate, and weekly activity against a personal goal. The Today page also
shows a filterable worldwide feed of public internship and co-op listings, refreshed daily from
the Pitt CSC and Simplify internship tracker.

Entries start in the visitor's own browser. Optional Google or verified-email sign-in can sync
the notebook to a private Firebase document restricted to that user's ID. The app has no ads and
does not use notebook content for marketing. JSON backup export/import remains available.

The source code is plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with no third-party runtime dependencies
and no build step, plus an optional Java backend for a local-only, single-user version.

- [Source code](https://github.com/will-iam08/internship-notebook): the full, public source repository
- [Live app](https://internshipnotebook.app/): the app itself, not a marketing page
